summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload unrelated to package purpose
details: The package is advertised as a Vue merge-tag input UI component but declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, marks it executable, and invokes it against a 727KB sibling file `math_init.js`. Both `setup.mjs` (the dropper) and `math_init.js` (the payload executed under Bun) are heavily obfuscated: `setup.mjs` uses obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, per-function property-dictionary indirection) despite being small install plumbing, and `math_init.js` is a single-line file beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs` and uses the `arr.push(arr.shift())` string-array cipher with hex-obfuscated identifiers. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: fetching a second-language runtime at install time to execute an opaque payload evades Node-based inspection, and the payload's shape and size have no relation to a Vue UI component. Installing this package auto-runs the obfuscated Bun payload on the installer's machine via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
